Similar figures and similar triangles: Similar: same shape; equal angles and proportional sides.
Basic Proportionality Theorem: DE ∥ BC gives AD/DB = AE/EC (Thales' theorem).
Criteria for similarity of triangles: AA, SSS and SAS prove triangles similar.
Areas of similar triangles and Pythagora: Area ratio = (side ratio)²; c² = a² + b² for right triangles.
